title: Remove the branch migration tool
body:
`sync/migrate_branch.py` was added in #294 to move in-flight edit branches from the atomized layout onto the consolidated one. That work is now complete — every open edit branch has been migrated, offered a migration, or is being handled directly with its author.

It's a single-use tool for an event that has passed, and it doesn't generalise. It re-expresses `split(head)` against `split(new-main)`, which carries a branch's whole tree rather than its change: a branch whose base is behind main migrates as a revert of everything main gained in the meantime. The round-trip check composes the migrated split against composing the branch's own `content/`, so it compares the branch to itself and reports that case as clean.

Nothing imports it, no tests cover it, no workflow calls it. The one prose reference in `partition.py` is updated here.
author: adamgfraser
